_note: After Care card wording for the after-service email. Confirmed by Ty 2026-10-09. Keys are categories; service_codes lists which RealGreen service codes trigger each category. Rounds 1 and 6 (M1, M6) use lawn_optional: watering in is optional, not required (Ty 2026-10-26).

lawn.label: Lawn Care
lawn.body: Today's treatment should be watered into the soil by tomorrow morning, either by rainfall or your sprinklers. Please keep children and pets off the lawn until it's dry or has been watered in.

lawn_optional.label: Lawn Care
lawn_optional.body: Watering in today's treatment is optional, not required. Rain or your sprinklers can help it along, but you don't need to water just for this visit. Please keep children and pets off the lawn until it's dry.

pest.label: Pest Control
pest.body: Unlike your lawn treatments, this doesn't need to be watered in, watering it too soon can actually wash away the barrier before it has a chance to work. Please keep children and pets off treated areas until the product has fully dried, typically within a few hours depending on weather, but the surest sign is that it's visibly dry to the touch.

tree.label: Tree & Shrub
tree.body: Please keep children and pets away from treated trees and shrubs until the application has fully dried, typically within a few hours depending on weather.
